subject: CAIQ evidence intake and control sampling plan for Arcadia Financial
messages:

Date: 2026-07-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ questionnaire and evidence request - Arcadia Financial

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is the CAIQ export from our procurement team — it's the full spreadsheet with our prioritized questions and a short redline section for any items that require additional context. We are aiming to complete the review and have a signed attestation by the end of August so procurement can close the contract.

Can you confirm:
- Who from Redwood will own the control-level responses?
- What evidence artifacts you'll need for the sampling window (logs, configs, screenshots, attestations)?
- Whether you can provide a secure upload location for artifacts and whether you support limited-time access tokens for our security team?

Arcadia Financial

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@arcadia-fin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, security@arcadia-fin.com
Date: 2026-07-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ questionnaire and evidence request - Arcadia Financial

Maria — thanks for the export and timeline. I reviewed the sheet and sketched a pragmatic intake plan below. We can meet the end-of-Aug target if we align scope this week.

Summary of approach:
- Triage & scope (48h): we identify which CAIQ controls are in-scope for production (P0) vs out-of-scope or vendor-managed (P1).
- Owner mapping (3 business days): assign Redwood owners for each P0 control (GRC, infra, product).
- Evidence sampling (2 weeks): collect representative artifacts (log samples, config snapshots, network diagram, retention policy statements, and attestation statements).
- Review & narrative (1 week): draft the control responses and rationales; provide crosswalk to our SOC 2 artifacts where applicable.

Initial asks from Arcadia to size effort:
1) Confirm the CAIQ tabs you want us to prioritize (we saw 3 tabs labeled: enterprise, infra, thirdparty).
2) Sampling window — are you expecting 90-day log samples or longer?
3) Any specific format required for artifact uploads (S3 presigned, secure Drive link, encrypted email)?

Internal owners I plan to loop in now: Kimberly (GRC lead) for control narratives, Marissa (evidence bundling) for artifact packaging, Jonas (infra) for network/log pulls.

I created a starter index for our internal intake: redwood_proposed-evidence-index.csv (attached). Can the Arcadia security team confirm whether 90 days is sufficient for log sampling or whether you need 180? Also please share the contact at procurement who will sign the attestation.

Proposed dates: intake kickoff call Thu 2026-07-22 10:00 PT. If that works I'll send an invite and a secure upload link.

Attachments: redwood_proposed-evidence-index.csv (csv)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

On Wed, Jul 21, 2026 at 10:03 AM neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Maria — thanks for the export and timeline. I reviewed the sheet and sketched a pragmatic intake plan below. We can meet the end-of-Aug target if we align scope this week.

Quick assignments from GRC side (putting timelines inline):
- Kimberly Park: control narratives & SOC 2 crosswalk owner (deliver draft for controls assigned by 2026-07-28).
- Marissa Cole: evidence bundle curator; will coordinate artifact naming conventions and upload protocol (deliver initial bundle by 2026-08-04).
- Jonas Weber: infra owner for network/ops logs and runtime config pulls (will provide sample extracts by 2026-07-30).

Kimberly notes: for any control that depends on ephemeral infra (canary nodes, autoscaling), we'll provide architectural justification plus one-week runbook and a 90-day sampling of relevant logs unless Arcadia requests 180 days. For data residency and encryption controls we'll attach KMS policy excerpts and key rotation attestations.

Let's use the Drive folder Neha created for initial uploads; we'll then move verified artifacts into a signed archive for delivery.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, GRC & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@arcadia-fin.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@arcadia-fin.com, security@arcadia-fin.com
Date: 2026-07-22T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ questionnaire and evidence request - Arcadia Financial

Thanks Neha and team — the plan looks good. A couple clarifications from Arcadia security and procurement: 

- Tabs to prioritize: enterprise and infra first; thirdparty only for controls that reference Redwood-managed dependencies.
- Sampling window: 90 days is acceptable for most items; for retention and encryption proofs we may ask for the longest demonstrated retention period (up to 12 months) if those controls are scoping substitution for SOC 2.
- Upload: please use the Google Drive link you referenced and set folder-level expiration to 30 days after final delivery. If you cannot set expiration on Drive, let us know and we'll provide an S3 presigned approach.

Maria attached a short procurement note requiring an evidence manifest with filenames, control IDs, owner, and date range for each artifact. Also please include network-diagrams.pdf that shows egress filters and VPC boundaries.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CArcadiaCAIQ
Procurement note: procurement@arcadia-fin.com

Regards,
Maria Gomez
Senior Security Manager
Arcadia Financial

- Control narratives draft (Kimberly) — due 2026-07-28.
- Infra log samples & config snapshots (Jonas) — due 2026-07-30 (will include 90-day window; note if you need 180d we'll extend).
- Evidence bundle initial package & manifest (Marissa) — due 2026-08-04.
- Network diagram and egress filter snapshot (Jonas) — attaching network-diagrams.pdf to Drive.

Uploads in Drive (seeded): redwood_proposed-evidence-index.csv, network-diagrams.pdf, canary_log_sample_20260720.txt. We'll set the folder share to Arcadia security and procurement and remove access 30 days after final delivery. If you prefer S3 with presigned URLs, we can switch — let us know.

Next step: kickoff call Thu 2026-07-22 10:00 PT (invite sent). If anyone at Arcadia needs a scoped log extract sooner (e.g., for a single control), reply to this thread and we'll prioritize.
